video:video.video:title: The Silent Way AI is Destroying Corporate Trust | Katherine Tuominen
video:video.video:description: Katherine Tuominen explains how AI-generated communication creates narrative debt, why frontline workarounds expose private data, and what leaders can do to preserve trust during technology change.

video:video.video:title: Why Lawyers Should Be Terrified of This AI Stat
video:video.video:description: Bennett Borden explains what ten years of legal time-entry data revealed about recurring legal work, why AI adoption is primarily psychological, and how defensible governance moves from theory into operating systems.

video:video.video:title: A Doctor Warns: Stop Reading Your Own Lab Results Using AI | Dr. Steven Labkoff
video:video.video:description: Dr. Steven Labkoff explains why using general-purpose AI to interpret personal lab results can produce confident but clinically dangerous conclusions and why healthcare AI literacy matters.

video:video.video:title: The Compliance Illusion: Why Written AI Policies Fail in Seconds
video:video.video:description: Aaron Puckett explains why an AI policy is only as strong as the infrastructure beneath it, how shadow AI exposes sensitive data, and which technical controls turn governance from paperwork into operational protection.

video:video.video:title: Your CISO Can't Govern What They Can't See | The Shadow Formulary Problem
video:video.video:description: Dr. Ömer Atlı explains the shadow formulary: consumer AI already used in clinical decisions, the lethal omissions standard evaluations miss, and why safe healthcare AI must be resource-aware.

video:video.video:title: Why 50% of New Nurses Quit Within 2 Years | Angela Millan
video:video.video:description: Angela Millan explains why many new nurses leave the bedside within two years, how clinical knowledge differs from judgment under pressure, and how Prismn's Nurse Hazel helps students build reasoning without replacing it.

video:video.video:title: Don't Upload Your Medical Record to ChatGPT — Here's Why
video:video.video:description: Dr. Terry Adirim explains why patients should never upload a complete medical record to a general-purpose LLM and how to use AI health information safely.

video:video.video:title: The AI Governance Problem Nobody's Talking About
video:video.video:description: Ethan Seib explains where unsupervised AI agents fail, how operational governance works, and which business decisions must remain human-controlled.

video:video.video:title: The Addiction Treatment Crisis No One's Talking About
video:video.video:description: David Sichel explains why a missed 3 AM addiction-treatment call can be a patient-safety event and how responsible AI can support a safe human handoff.

video:video.video:title: AI in Healthcare: The Hidden Reason It's Not Scaling
video:video.video:description: Dr. Angel Mena explains why hospital AI pilots fail to scale and what clinical, operational, legal, and governance leaders must settle first.

video:video.video:title: Why AI Agents Are Healthcare's Biggest Security Risk
video:video.video:description: Pranava Adduri explains how autonomous AI agents enlarge healthcare security risk, permission drift, and the potential blast radius of a breach.

video:video.video:title: The $100M Mistake CFOs Make by Going Late on AI
video:video.video:description: Gary Cao explains why delaying enterprise AI investment creates compounding data, workforce, and strategic costs that CFOs cannot recover quickly.

video:video.video:title: Why Healthcare AI Pilots Fail Before They Scale
video:video.video:description: Brian Sutherland explains why healthcare AI pilots fail before they scale and how trust, governance, workflow, and leadership close the execution gap.

video:video.video:title: AI Drug Discovery Has a Verification Problem
video:video.video:description: David Finkelshteyn explains why verification, data integrity, and defensible validation are now the bottlenecks in AI-accelerated drug discovery.

video:video.video:title: AI Governance Fails Without Cybersecurity
video:video.video:description: Guman Chauhan explains why AI governance fails without cybersecurity, executive accountability, and monitoring designed for AI-specific threats.

video:video.video:title: Clinical AI Must Give Time Back to Patients
video:video.video:description: Dr. Mark Gendreau explains why clinical AI succeeds only when it gives time back to clinicians and patients while preserving human judgment.
